saw_lines: Watch buyers rarely buy on impulse. They compare models for weeks and want proof the maker stands behind it for decades.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this model deserves a closer look.
Your site shows 150 years and 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the 150 year figure on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: Your site leads with 150 years, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust the claim. Open two ads with the 150 year figure and a review quote.

0 of 30 ads are video, so a buyer sees the watch only as a still frame and never sees the dial catch light. Shoot three videos of the Ingenieur SL on a wrist, then test them against the oldest winner.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Answer the shipping question in the first line of ads aimed at new buyers.

9 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the other 21 ads reuses a winner’s opening line, so good copy stays trapped in one ad. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, started in April 2026.

ads_1: Ingenieur SL video and proof-led creative, built on the oldest winner’s opening line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Tiktok, X, Youtube
